title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.7.5
subtitle: Direct learning access and Lumen as the preferred solver.

highlights.title: Learning Center in Preferences
highlights.description: Open the published Cloth NeXt Learning Center directly from the Learn Cloth NeXt section alongside Welcome and What's New.

highlights.title: Lumen by default
highlights.description: New solver installations now default to Lumen. Existing verified Velune installations remain usable, while the download list offers only Lumen.
